context: batch s151b, independent S8 audit: two new briefs, ocd (Obsessive-Compulsive and Related Disorders, a psychiatry disease brief on decision spine v2) and capacity (Decision-Making Capacity and Informed Consent, a Preventive & Ethics lookup brief), each audited whole

types.ocd: disease brief (obsessive-compulsive disorder with the related disorders: body dysmorphic, hoarding, trichotillomania, excoriation; OCPD, GAD, illness anxiety, tics, psychosis and postpartum psychosis as look-alikes), psychiatry; an intro line after the bottom line (DSM-5 lists OCD separately from the anxiety disorders); review in full
types.capacity: lookup brief (decision-making capacity, informed consent, surrogates), fm lens; new brief; a lookup brief carries tables and a commitment rule instead of the eight spine steps (model: defense-mechanisms, s150c); review in full

acc: Where a board source (AnKing card, UWorld, NBME) and a guideline differ, the brief teaches the board answer and puts the guideline in an "In practice:" hover (runbook section 3): the hover is intended, not a finding.
Word counts are not judged (2026-10-19 layers rule: nothing is cut for length).

Settled by Jonathan at launch (do not report): tics keeps tic-related OCD and its ERP lines and peds-alopecia keeps trichotillomania, with ocd pointing to both; ocd carries an OCPD contrast row (no drawer: a cluster C brief is on hold); minors' consent stays with Adolescent Confidentiality; capacity was built without its missing UWorld QID.

ocd lead calls (judge accuracy, not the choice): onset ages are not taught (no board item keys one); PANDAS cards are scoped out (contested label, STANDING_DIRECTIONS); step 6 is a Measure and specify table with no Y-BOCS score bar because no source gives score bands.

capacity lint answered: S057, S060 and S077 drop "may" from "The brother may act as a surrogate ... only if": that "may" grants permission and is not a hedge; the claims keep the condition. Judge whether the claim still matches the quote.

The cached AAFP 2018 capacity article is truncated after a few sentences per paragraph; only complete sentences are cited. Audit cards_disposition.json against cards.md: every covered entry must name claim ids that teach the card.
New primary facts h01 to h05 (capacity) come from the UW Department of Bioethics and Humanities page, fetched 2026-10-24; judge whether the new therapeutic-privilege lines match those quotes.
This is the independent S8 audit (the launch budget names it). You have not seen any earlier receipt or the lead's adjudication: judge the brief cold, as a fresh accuracy reviewer would.

Claim-level entailment (the s150b audit's MED C class): for every claim, each action, test, drug, threshold or recommendation the line states must be stated by one of its cited facts (claim_map.json ids, quotes in facts.json); a fact about the same topic is not enough. Report a stated action no cited quote states.

Card child coverage (the s150b audit's MED D class): for each card marked covered:S### in cards_disposition.json, read the card's high-yield lines in cards.md and check that the named claims teach each high-yield statement, including a child statement inherited from its parent card; report a covered card whose named claims teach a different part of the card.
Layers rule (Jonathan 2026-10-19): a fact a board item keys (the answer, or the clue that rules out a distractor) must stay visible, not only in a hover. Report a keyed fact found only in a hover.

Brief set rules (Jonathan 2026-10-20): every practice item carries three reasons ("reasons: key | d1 | d2" on its item line), each the choice's defining feature or the fact in the stem that rules it out; a distractor that is a differential row reuses that row's wording. Judge each reason for Step 2 truth on that stem and agreement with the body and the item's explanation.
Every age, cutoff, duration and interval against the cited quote and the board sources in facts.json (kind board first).
Card dispositions: spot-check that each "covered" card's fact is taught by the claims it names, and that no carded fact the bank tests is marked scope or not-topic.
